opportunities.title: Institutional Engagement Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Society Representatives and members; applications must be supported by a Society Representative or a Fellow.
opportunities.summary: Provides funding to support Society Representatives and members to host events at their organisation, including internal conferences, teaching symposia, seminars or outreach events.

opportunities.title: Unlocking Futures Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to postdoctoral researchers (members) who require additional support to help them achieve their full potential.
opportunities.summary: Provides support to postdoctoral researchers who require additional help to achieve their full potential, enhancing their commitment to physiology and benefiting the wider community of physiologists.

opportunities.title: Education and Teaching Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Members; the applicant's host institution must be willing to administer the award.
opportunities.summary: Supports members wishing to develop new educational resources or conduct a piece of publishable educational research that addresses a key question in physiological education. Applications for 2026 are closed and will reopen in autumn 2026.

opportunities.title: Research and Knowledge Exchange Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Members; the applicant's host institution must be willing to administer the award.
opportunities.summary: Supports members wishing to conduct pilot studies, develop a new technique or finalise a project, as well as supporting activities to promote knowledge transfer and impact. Applications for 2026 are closed and will reopen in autumn 2026.

opportunities.title: Equity, Diversity and Inclusion Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Undergraduate & Masters, Postgraduate, Full member or Fellow of the Physiological Society in their second year of membership or longer.
opportunities.summary: Provides support for Members to run activities that address the principles of Equity, Diversity and Inclusion in the physiological sciences, in either teaching or research. Applications have closed for 2026 and will reopen in 2027.
